notes.title: Update 1.1.11 - Controller Hotfix
notes.notes:
Some players have been experiencing a problem with specific controllers when changing the game controls.
We appreciate the patience and all the details on the reports that are helping us track this down.

[h2]This update should avoid any player to be locked on the start screen.[/h2]

Important:
[list]
[*] If you're locked on the start screen, try disconnecting your controller and progressing with mouse and keyboard.
[*] Make sure you're playing the 1.1.11 version.
[/list]

notes.title: FORGOTTEN CRYPTS - New Major Update! Check out the list of new content
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/a4253667da27ec05b8ad7bd85014b83407312fa3.png[/img]

We're happy to announce we're launching a new DLC called FORGOTTEN CRYPTS!!
Your game should automatically update.

[h1]How much does it cost?[/h1]
For players who gave us their support before the price rise: ZERO!
After the DLC launch, [b]the game base price will have a rise[/b] to reflect the price of the new content.


[h1]ːarrowwː A BRAND NEW CHARACTER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/dd6b53fdbb059ec9b3f6c589bbbd2549841f80d1.jpg[/img]
She attacks with a boomerang!
The boomerang also marks enemies as target for her loyal dog!!
Galiana, the Naturalist, dedicates her life to study plants and animals and how these can help humans survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/3e2bbed8cbee416aa2c2b29bc5e7328779bcfef3.gif[/img]

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW SCENARIO & NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/6dff297aaee93a57efb5d231d612331f467dcbf0.png[/img]
New challenging floors to explore and put your strategy to the proof.

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW UNLOCKABLE: SKILLS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/94b611df6efac00a8dc7af4e2fda9874b8be0a8c.gif[/img]
A new NPC has joined us in the encampment.
He has some valuable knowledge to share about new combat techniques.

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW ITEMS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/5826655b1e8bb1f3b1ba6a9d1ca25b48878d36e4.png[/img]
We had 31 in total, and we're adding 21 new ones! These are some of our favorites.
We hope this is going to add a lot of variety to the runs.


And one more thing...


[h1]ːarrowwː LOCAL CO-OP MODE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/4a3f96422ef65d2beb7392dc60da7a2b291bce43.png[/img]
On a Sonic & Tails fashion, now you can explore the dungeons with a friend! The Player 2 gets to control the dog while Player 1 controls any of the 4 characters.
This is not meant to be a hard challenge, but rather a very joyful two-players experience.

[h1]ABOUT SWITCH[/h1]
Qubic Games is the publisher responsible for the porting of Mana Spark on Switch and they're working to port the DLC. They also helped the development with part of the funding, so, it's in their best interest to port the new DLC as fast as possible.
We still don't have a launch date for Switch, but it'll not take long now.


That's it. We worked hard on this and we really hope you like it!
Cheers,
-Ed

notes.title: Quality of Life Update!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/b932b0c17b0af534dfc220dc4527d3357dfb926d.png[/img]
[h1]Quality of Life Update v1.0.21[/h1]
Since the launch in September we've been updating the game, fixing bugs, removing and adding things players have pointed out to us.

Today what we have is a slightly bigger update that we think will make playing our game a better experience:

[b]New Map Movement System[/b]
Open the map / choose any room already visited / there you are!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/8a4fccdeaa6ec282268b0103110235f291898d6f.png[/img]
[b]Faster movement when out of combat[/b]
More mobility! Can be disabled on Options Menu.

[b]New Poison System[/b]
Stepping on poison won't get you poisoned immediately. It's only fair, right?

[b]Convenient Loot Grab[/b]
Gold and runes are automatically collected after you clear a room. Why not?

[b]Reducing Loading Times[/b]
The game now loads faster between floors.

[b]A Bunch of Bug Fixing[/b]
Some were simple, some were more severe, but what matters is that they've been fixed.

[b]Supported Languages[/b]
We now have:
[list][*] English
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] French
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Spanish - Latin America
[/list]

[h1]A Word About New Content[/h1]
We're not blind. We've seen your feedback on the forums and on reviews requesting new content. New enemies, new items, new areas. It breaks our hearts to read this from players that loved the game, but think the game is not on its full potential because of the lack of content.

And I agree with that.

We've been making some evaluations and we were even talking with a publisher that had some interest on investing on a paid DLC.
The truth is, the sales of the game were not terrible, but it didn't let room for a significant update. If we work on this and it doesn't bring enough results it could put us out of business.

With all that being said, I'd like to know from you:
[list]
[*] What kind of new content would you like to see?
[*] Would you be cool with paying (between 2$ and 5$) for the DLC?
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/a6f9bf0a7f6b7d2bc570284b6c27925ee9192d63.jpg[/img]
